modInfo: В данной школе вы сможете найти кабинет музыки, кабинет рисования, гардероб, столовую, прачечную, а так же кабинет охраны. Но вот что на втором этаже знают лишь выжившие, которые стали одними из этих тварей.

Before the zombie apocalypse, it was an ordinary West Point school. But when one of the students became dead during a regular music lesson, the school became a real hell. Some students managed to barricade the stairs on the second floor and were able to survive well. They began to collect good stocks of weapons and thought that they would survive and be rescued by the military, but they did not yet know that the virus was transmitted by airborne droplets...

In this school you can find a music room, an art room, a wardrobe, a dining room, a laundry room, as well as a security office. But that's what only the survivors on the second floor know, who have become one of these creatures.
